title: Ensemble node: node.yaml
description: One node: a worker that gives this computer's power to the people of a hub server. In ~/.config/ensemble/node.yaml, or a file of its own for each further node. Nothing has a default value; a block under `offers` that is left out is not offered.

name.description: Its name on the hub, which knows it as <owner>/<name>: letters, digits, '-', '_' or '.'.

access.description: private: it works for its owner alone. shared: also for everyone whose role has `compute`; connecting it needs `host`. A shared node offers only agents that run on llm_backends, never on an agent CLI's subscription.

projects.description: An issue's `project`, and the absolute folder on this computer its work happens in. A task whose project is not here is refused, and the issue says so. `{}` when there are none.

runs.description: Agents of a helper team on this computer, which others name with an agent of `type: node`. A task gets a copy of the files git tracks, works in a folder of its own, and sends back what it changed.

team.description: The absolute directory of a helper team, with its config.yaml.

agents.description: Which of its agents may run here.

models.description: Models an OpenAI-compatible server on this computer serves, reached through the hub at https://<hub>/nodes/v1 with an access token as the API key.

base_url.description: The server's OpenAI-compatible base URL, such as http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1.

api_key_env.description: The environment variable holding the server's API key, when it needs one.

timeout_seconds.description: The most one request may take.

names.description: The models offered, as the server names them.
